approved_proposal: Use a narrowly defined capture-repeatability allowance: one colour-level variation in a small explicitly capped number of background pixels; exclude approved-model, worklight and emitter regions; keep prototype-versus-generic comparisons, source hashes and simulation hashes strict; add negative tests and rerun the full S05 matrix.
numeric_cap_selection: Engineering interpretation of the approved small fixed cap, not a quoted owner-selected number. Fixed at 128 pixels before implementation; fail closed beyond it, never increase automatically to fit results.
protected_regions: Conservative camera-projected regions covering all three approved model instances and their worklights/emitters, derived from immutable mesh geometry and actual entity transforms; include safety padding and fail closed for invalid projections.
scope: Within-source repeated frozen frames only. Never cross-source prototype/generic comparison, feature ablation/restoration, simulation digest, source hash, mesh hash, or legacy discrimination.
required_evidence: Fail amplitude > 1, changed pixels > 128, or any change inside protected regions
Fail closed for malformed images, invalid masks or unusable projections
Retain and report every tolerated nonzero repeated-frame difference and its mask
Prove cross-source parity stays exact and negative controls still fail
Run full original colour/motion/combat/per-feature matrix with unchanged production quality
